title: Key Account Pleno/Sênior
description:
Key Account Pleno/Sênior

Gestão Estratégica de Contas · Expansão de Receita · Relacionamento Consultivo


SOBRE A POSIÇÃO:

Buscamos um profissional com profunda capacidade de construção e gestão de relacionamentos de alto valor, visão estratégica de longo prazo e histórico comprovado na expansão sustentável de carteiras complexas. O Key Account Pleno/Sênior será o guardião das contas mais relevantes da organização — responsável não apenas por preservar a receita existente, mas por identificar, estruturar e capturar sistematicamente novas oportunidades dentro do ecossistema de cada cliente.


Mais do que um gestor de relacionamento, este profissional atua como um parceiro estratégico do cliente: alguém capaz de compreender profundamente os desafios do negócio, antecipar necessidades, propor soluções de alto impacto e influenciar decisões em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos. Internamente, posiciona-se como referência técnica e comportamental para o time de contas, colaborando diretamente com as lideranças comerciais na definição de estratégias de retenção, crescimento e expansão.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Gestão e Expansão de Carteira

  • Gerir com autonomia e profundidade uma carteira de contas estratégicas, desenvolvendo planos de conta individualizados com metas claras de retenção, crescimento e aprofundamento de relacionamento.
  • Identificar e estruturar oportunidades de up-sell e cross-sell de forma proativa, com base em análise de maturidade do cliente, consumo atual e potencial de expansão.
  • Monitorar indicadores de saúde das contas (health score, NPS, churn risk, expansão de receita), traduzindo dados em ações táticas e planos de mitigação.
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas de negócio (QBRs e EBRs) com stakeholders estratégicos dos clientes, apresentando resultados, roadmaps de valor e iniciativas conjuntas de crescimento.


Relacionamento e Influência Estratégica

  • Construir e aprofundar relacionamentos em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos dentro dos clientes — operacional, gerencial e executivo — criando vínculos de longo prazo baseados em confiança e entrega de valor consistente.
  • Posicionar-se como consultor de confiança do cliente, antecipando necessidades, propondo iniciativas antes que sejam demandadas e participando ativamente de discussões sobre estratégia e resultados do negócio do cliente.
  • Mapear e gerenciar o ecossistema de influenciadores e decisores de cada conta, desenvolvendo estratégias de engajamento customizadas por persona.
  • Atuar como defensor interno do cliente, garantindo que as demandas e expectativas das contas estratégicas sejam priorizadas adequadamente pelas áreas de produto, operações e suporte.


Retenção e Crescimento de Receita

  • Ser o principal responsável pelo atingimento das metas de Net Revenue Retention (NRR) e Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) da carteira sob gestão.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de renovação antecipada e condução de processos de renegociação complexos, equilibrando flexibilidade comercial com preservação de margem e percepção de valor.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais estratégicas e materiais de apresentação executiva, com narrativa clara orientada ao ROI e ao impacto de negócio do cliente.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que a entrega sustente a percepção de valor e reduza o risco de churn.


Inteligência de Mercado e Contribuição Estratégica

  • Monitorar movimentos competitivos, tendências de mercado e mudanças no ambiente de negócios dos clientes estratégicos, utilizando esse conhecimento para antecipar riscos e oportunidades.
  • Contribuir com insights qualificados para o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas, ajustes de posicionamento e evolução de estratégias comerciais, a partir da escuta ativa e do relacionamento próximo com as contas.
  • Reportar com consistência e precisão os KPIs de carteira para as lideranças, apresentando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas fundamentadas.
  • Atuar como mentor e referência para profissionais de contas em estágios anteriores de carreira, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento do time e a evolução das práticas de gestão de contas da organização.


COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS:

  • Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de gestão de carteira, com capacidade para estruturar pipelines de expansão, acompanhar health scores e gerar relatórios executivos com precisão analítica.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados de conta — consumo, receita, engajamento, risco — para transformar informações em estratégias de ação e narrativas de valor junto ao cliente.
  • Proficiência na construção de planos de conta (account plans) estruturados, incluindo mapeamento de stakeholders, análise de whitespace e definição de iniciativas prioritárias de expansão.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos de alto nível — QBRs, EBRs, propostas de valor e business cases — com rigor metodológico e clareza de comunicação.
  • Experiência com frameworks de gestão de contas estratégicas (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC, Miller Heiman ou equivalentes) aplicados ao contexto de expansão e retenção.
  • Fluência em ferramentas de comunicação, videoconferência e colaboração remota para condução eficaz de interações com clientes distribuídos geograficamente.


PERFIL E REQUISITOS:

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de contas estratégicas, Customer Success sênior ou vendas consultivas B2B com carteira de clientes de alto valor.
  • Histórico comprovado de expansão de receita em carteiras complexas, com métricas documentadas de NRR, up-sell e cross-sell.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade de interpretar dados de negócio, construir argumentos estratégicos e sustentar recomendações com evidências.
  • Habilidade de navegação em organizações complexas, com experiência em engajamento multi-stakeholder e influência sem autoridade formal.
  • Capacidade de liderança e mentoria para contribuir com o desenvolvimento de profissionais de contas em estágios mais iniciais de carreira.
  • Certificações em metodologias de gestão de contas, negociação estratégica ou vendas consultivas (diferencial).
  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA é considerado diferencial.
  • Trabalho 100% Presencial
  • Disponibilidade para Viajar uma vez por semana


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Visão de longo prazo e orientação estratégica — compreende que a gestão de contas é construída em horizontes de tempo, não em transações isoladas.
  • Inteligência relacional — lê dinâmicas interpessoais com acuidade, adapta o estilo de comunicação por interlocutor e constrói confiança com consistência.
  • Mentalidade de dono — assume responsabilidade integral pelos resultados da carteira, sem esperar que o ambiente externo dite o ritmo.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados — transita com naturalidade entre o relacionamento e a análise, usando ambos como instrumentos de criação de valor.
  • Proatividade estruturada — identifica oportunidades antes que se tornem óbvias e age com método, não por impulso.
  • Comunicação executiva — articula ideias complexas com clareza e precisão, tanto no nível operacional quanto no estratégico.
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional — mantém qualidade de presença e raciocínio em situações de pressão, renegociação e complexidade.


BENEFÍCIOS & EXPERIÊNCIA NA EMPRESA:

Aqui, você não encontra apenas um pacote de benefícios — encontra um ambiente pensado para alta performance, longevidade profissional e desenvolvimento real.

  • Cartão Flash flexível (alimentação / refeição / mobilidade)

  • Café da manhã diário no escritório


Alta Performance & Saúde Integral

Acreditamos que performance sustentável exige corpo e mente alinhados. Programa Alta Performance e Vitalidade. Acesso a:

  • Treinamento físico com parceiros especializados (Elite Training)
  • Acompanhamento nutricional
  • TotalPass (academias e bem-estar)
  • Consultas médicas
  • Cantinho da Pausa & Bem-Estar — um espaço pensado para manter energia e foco ao longo do dia, com café premium, seleção de chás, frutas e snacks disponíveis durante todo o expediente


Desenvolvimento de Alto Nível

Investimos de forma intencional na formação de profissionais diferenciados — tecnicamente e intelectualmente:

  • Treinamento Em Busca da Verdade (EBV): Mais do que um treinamento, uma formação intelectual e humana. Acesso a uma sociedade de estudos clássicos voltada ao desenvolvimento de líderes com pensamento crítico, profundidade e visão de longo prazo.
  • Cursos de Aperfeiçoamento
  • Incentivo contínuo ao seu crescimento
  • Especializações técnicas
  • Desenvolvimento de soft skills (ex: oratória, comunicação, negociação)
  • Capacitações alinhadas às demandas da sua atuação


Cultura e Ambiente

  • Cultura orientada à alta performance com responsabilidade
  • Proximidade com tomada de decisão e impacto direto no negócio
  • Ambiente meritocrático, com espaço real para crescimento
  • Troca constante com profissionais de alto nível

title: Gerente de contas
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Mapeamento de mercado e identificação de clientes em potencial para os serviços oferecidos no portfólio da empresa;
  • Prospecção e visita de clientes potenciais, identificando novas oportunidades e buscando o crescimento da receita;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais dentro de cada cliente para captação de novos projetos apoiando sempre de forma consultiva para melhor integração da TI ao negócio;
  • Elaboração de propostas comerciais;
  • Negociação de taxas com clientes e profissionais para atingir o target necessário para fechamento do negócio de acordo com as metas estabelecidas;
  • Apoio aos clientes ativos nas rotinas necessárias para que os processos internos sejam atendidos;
  • Negociação de pagamento com clientes inadimplentes;
  • Interface das demandas comerciais com o sistema BullHorn (abertura de oportunidades e abastecimento de informações até o fechamento da oportunidade ou declínio);


O que você precisa ter

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Gestão de Negócios ou áreas afins;
  • Desejável Pós-graduação em Marketing ou área afins;
  • Conhecimento avançado em técnicas de vendas e negociação;
  • Conhecimento avançado nas ferramentas Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Excelente capacidade de planejamento, gerenciamento estratégico, foco em resultados, visão de longo prazo, senso de urgência, disciplina, relacionamento interpessoal e resiliência.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Company Description


MingYang Electric is a global leader in power equipment, with a presence in over 70 countries and regions. The company is committed to supporting the global transition to green and low carbon energy with a focus on Transformer Solutions, Switchgear Solutions, and prefabricated & All-in-One Systems.




Role Description


This is a full-time role for a Regional Sales Manager located in South America. The Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing sales strategies, managing customer relationships, and achieving sales targets within the region, including North America. Day-to-day tasks include identifying new business opportunities, conducting market research, overseeing pre-sales and project management activities, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction and business growth. While remote work is acceptable, occasional on-site engagements may be necessary to support key accounts or regional operations.



Qualifications


Technical background in transformer, switchgear or power industry is highly recommended

Communication and customer service skills

Sales and Project Management experience

Excellent organizational and time management skills

title: Operador de USV
description:
Sobre a TideWise

A TideWise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Operadores de USV para integrar nossa equipe de operações. Esta é uma posição que une a experiência marítima tradicional com a fronteira da robótica. Você será responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


1. Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo)

  • Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão.
  • Executar watchkeeping remoto, mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM.
  • Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões.


2. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução

  • Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação.
  • Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões.
  • Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção.
  • Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões.
  • Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações.


3. Manobras e Modos de Operação

  • Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP), decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação.


4. Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética

  • Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e \"quase acidentes\").
  • Operar sob procedimentos de contingência: quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos).


5. Registros e Evidências

  • Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes.
  • Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução).


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Aquaviário do 1º Grupo (Marítimo) – Seção de Convés: Oficial de Náutica (ON) ou CTR (Nível 5+).
  • Certificações: STCW válidos e compatíveis (II/3, II/5 e IV/2 - Rádio-Operador).
  • Experiência Prática: Navegação de embarcações de pequeno porte (menor que 20m e propulsão com dois eixos).
  • Navegação em regiões de alta densidade de tráfego não controlado (pesca e recreio).
  • Vivência em ambiente offshore/portuário e rotinas de convés.
  • Tecnologia: Experiência prévia com operações remotas (COR/ROC), VTS/VTMIS ou sistemas não tripulados (USV/ROV/UAV).
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência com mobilização, integração de sensores, testes e comissionamento básico.
  • Idiomas: Inglês instrumental (leitura de manuais, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica).


Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills)

  • Disciplina operacional e rigor com normas/procedimentos.
  • Consciência situacional sob carga cognitiva e tomada de decisão sob pressão.
  • Comunicação clara, padronizada e fraseologia operacional (VHF).
  • Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar, ética e integridade.


Benefícios TideWise:

  • Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação e Mobilidade oferecidos no Cartão Caju Benefícios.
  • Adicional de 25% no Vale-Alimentação por filho com idade inferior a 21 anos.
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Dental Sulamérica sem coparticipação para colaboradores.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • WellHub.


Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo!

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases

  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

title: LIFECYCLE & RETENTION STRATEGIST (Klaviyo)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY

ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.

We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.

You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.

You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.

This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.


SCOPE OF WORK

Strategy and Campaign Planning

  • Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth eCommerce brands
  • Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
  • Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
  • Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
  • Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
  • Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
  • Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and ClickUp timelines on track
  • Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities

Optimization and Performance

  • Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
  • Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
  • Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training

Tech Stack Management and Recommendations

  • Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
  • Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, LoyaltyLion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, AfterShip), push notifications, and direct mail (PostPilot, PaperRun, etc.)
  • Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team

Client Collaboration

  • Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
  • Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
  • Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within eCommerce or DTC
  • Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
  • Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
  • Solid understanding of the eCommerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
  • Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
  • Proficiency with ClickUp (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
  • Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
  • Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud


HOW WE WORK

You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through ClickUp for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Endpoint System Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Endpoint System Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Endpoint Systems Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting endpoint platforms and tooling across customer environments within the Managed Services organization. This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Own the health, performance, and compliance of endpoint environments across customer environments.
  • Manage and maintain endpoint management platforms (MDM/RMM), including Intune and NinjaOne.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint health, patching, and compliance, ensuring successful deployment and remediation of OS and application updates.
  • Investigate and resolve endpoint-related issues, including performance, configuration, and policy enforcement problems.
  • Create and manage problem investigations for recurring or complex endpoint issues.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scripts and automation (PowerShell preferred) to support endpoint management and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain integrations between endpoint management tools and other systems (e.g., ITSM, monitoring platforms).
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and support teams to resolve cross-system issues impacting endpoints.
  • Maintain endpoint configuration standards, policies, and documentation.
  • Participate in change management processes for endpoint-related updates and deployments.
  • Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting endpoint management in an MSP, enterprise IT, or similar environment.
  • Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions).
  • Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne or similar platforms).
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID device management.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint administration and lifecycle management.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems.
  • Experience with patch management processes and tools.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and structured support processes.
  • Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation and tooling.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft, endpoint management, or cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Deep experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).

title: Billing analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2 B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.
Key Responsibilities
Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package:
- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).
- Profit Sharing.
- Transportation vouchers.
- Meals vouchers.
- Health and Dental insurance.
- Birthday day off.
- Gympass / Totalpass.
If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance.

Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.
III. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.

Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.
IV. Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.

title: Technical expert
description:
At Etex, our purpose is to inspire new ways of living.
We are an international leader in sustainable construction, driven by a passion for excellence, but it's our people that are our top priority.
We connect, collaborate, and champion the well-being of our employees, forming partnerships and pioneering change in our ever-evolving industry.
At Etex, we seek to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our customers and our communities.
Are you looking for a company where you can learn, grow and lead? Join us as an Technical Expert for Brazil, based in Río de Janeiro! The mission of the role is act as the key technical interface in large-scale industrial projects across South America, ensuring equipment specifications, installation, and performance meet Etex standards and international norms.
The role safeguards project delivery in terms of safety, timing, and budget, while supporting project managers and coordinating with suppliers, local teams, and stakeholders.
What you’ll do Develop technical specifications for equipment purchases and installations, aligned with Etex standards and customer requirements.
Review and align supplier proposals with international and group standards.
Monitor the full project lifecycle: engineering studies, manufacturing, acceptance tests, commissioning, start-up, and closure.
Supervise erection works on-site, ensuring safety and timely execution.
Provide recommendations to stakeholders to support decision-making.
Act as the interface between suppliers, local customers, operational teams, and project managers.
Support project managers with PMO methodology and reporting.
Manage budget responsibilities depending on project size.
Communicate effectively with multicultural teams and suppliers, maintaining leadership and authority.
What you’ll bring Engineering degree or confirmed technician background in mechanics or electricity/automation; knowledge of construction/civil works is a plus.
Minimum of 10 years’ experience in technical fields, with appetite for managing large technical projects.
Strong technical expertise in mechanics/electricity; proficiency in Auto CAD and MS Office.
PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.
Language skills: fluent English mandatory.
Strong communication skills and ability to challenge suppliers constructively.
Flexibility, resilience, and autonomy under remote management (Europe-based).
Ability to work collaboratively, avoiding silo mentality.
Why join us? We are named the world's #1 most trustworthy company in the construction sector by Newsweek and Statista in 2023! Our culture – we connect & care about those around us.
We nurture teamwork, communities, partnerships and new ways of working, placing the highest importance on the safety and working environment of our people.
Our ‘Road to Sustainability 2030’ is our plan to help build a better, sustainable future.
We work towards this vision by caring about our social and environmental impacts and developing innovative solutions We have a strong conviction that diversity of thinking helps us to deliver a strong and sustainable performance.
It is also essential for us that everyone feels part of the team.
In this spirit, we are committed to equal opportunities and zero tolerance towards discrimination Flexibility: For us, hybrid and flexible working is all about trust, and we want you to be able to do your best work (depending on the role).

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor companyactivities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

description:

title: Fx trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Consultor(a) de investimentos associado(a)
description:
Se você já atua no mercado financeiro e procura a melhor estrutura para atender seus clientes sem conflito de interesses, com boas perspectivas de carreira e sendo bem remunerado, essa vaga é para você!
Somos uma consultoria de investimentos que atende famílias em busca do crescimento patrimonial e da preservação do legado. Atendemos clientes em todos os grandes bancos e corretoras do Brasil e também nos EUA. Nosso modelo de atuação é 100% FEE BASED sem conflito de interesses.
ALOCAÇÃO: Somos associados ao grupo Nord Investimentos garantindo que as melhores estratégias de alocação estarão à disposição dos seus clientes, ou seja, você terá relatórios e calls de investimento independentes e de alta qualidade.
INDEPENDÊNCIA: Trabalhamos com todos os bancos no Brasil e temos integração com 3 instituições americanas (Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers e Avenue), ou seja, onde quer que seu cliente esteja, você poderá atendê-lo.
EXPERIÊNCIA: Temos um time experiente e com metodologia proprietária que ajuda na conversão de leads (90%) e retenção de clientes (churn menor que 0,50% ao ano).
CARREIRA: Nosso programa de partnership garante que você tenha oportunidade de aumentar sua participação societária no nosso grupo empresarial na medida em que seus resultados e contribuições cresçam. Nossa empresa também possui uma corretora de seguros completa (Monte Bianco Insurance) e uma área com soluções Corporate que atende PJ com empréstimos, cambio, energia e antecipação de recebíveis. Ou seja, aqui você pode oferecer uma oferta completa de produtos e serviços para seus clientes.
Essa proposta de valor em conjunto com nossa metodologia exclusiva tem resultado em mais de 90% de taxa de conversão de leads em clientes.
Estamos em busca de profissionais experientes da área de investimentos para ampliar a equipe da Monte Bianco Multi-Family Office (MBM) no Rio de Janeiro. Este cargo demanda a realização de recomendações financeiras especializadas, gerenciamento de carteiras de investimento e interação contínua com clientes para entender suas necessidades e objetivos financeiros. As responsabilidades diárias incluem análise de tendências de mercado, identificação de oportunidades de investimento e fornecimento de um serviço ao cliente de alta qualidade.
Qualificações
Investimentos e Finanças: necessário ter experiência prévia em atender clientes no mercado financeiro.
Relacionamento: garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam compreendidas e atendidas de maneira eficaz.
Prospecção: captação ativa de novos leads e desenvolvimento da estratégias para conversão Caso o candidato não possua nenhuma das certificações exigidas (CEA/CFP/CNPI), será concedido um prazo de 6 meses para que consiga se certificar.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world.
As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees.
On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us! Job challenges: - Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT; - Monitor, and enforce KNOT’s HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation; - Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements; - Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace; - Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses; - Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits; - Participate in emergency response drills and simulations; - Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures; Requirements: - Technical degree in Occupational Safety; - Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry; - Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested; - Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs); - Intermediate Excel skills; - Desirable: Bachelor’s degree; - Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer: - Food allowance; - Transportation allowance without discount; - Health and dental plan at no cost; - Life insurance; - Private pension; - Profit-Sharing; - Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Supervisor(a) de governança - gestão de governança
description:
Requisitos: -Desejável superior completo em Hotelaria ou cursando; -Necessário boa vivência com governança, hotelaria e higienização; -Necessário vivência com gestão de equipes e conhecimento de controle de enxoval.
Atividades: - Planejar e supervisionar as atividades de limpeza e desinfecção no ambiente hospitalar; - Acompanhar processos seletivos e realizar entrevistas de candidatos encaminhados pelos Recursos Humanos para contratação de novos colaboradores da equipe; - Realizar análise de potencial e desempenho, bem como entrevista de feedback; - Realizar em parceria com o RH, por meio de processos seletivos, capacitação e desenvolvimento técnico-profissional, a fim de minimizar custos de headcount e manter o quadro de profissionais qualificados e satisfeitos.
- Realizar reuniões mensais com a empresa de terceirização de limpeza, com objetivo de demonstrar os resultados; - Garantir o preenchimento do SLA, juntamente com a supervisora da empresa terceirizada; - Controlar o fluxo de atividades e implantação de rotinas do setor; - Garantir a guarda segura do mobiliário do hospital e inventário do mesmo; - Coordenar a substituição dos móveis danificados ou sempre que houver a solicitação do responsável de cada setor do hospital; - Acompanhar o controle de indicadores operacionais referentes aos setores sob a sua responsabilidade; - Controlar e gerir banco de horas e escalas da equipe; - Acompanhar a realização do inventário de enxoval e analisar a necessidade de reposição e controle do mesmo; - Garantir, de maneira segura, a guarda de pertences; - Garantir o cumprimento correto de todos os procedimentos padrão do setor, de forma a garantir a qualidade do serviço prestado; - Acompanhar o controle de uniformes da unidade; - Acompanhar o desempenho e avaliação de qualidade percebida dos clientes, de acordo com a ferramenta HFocus..
Outras informações: - Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro.
- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - 08h às 18h (segunda à sexta-feira).
- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

description:

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho
description:
Atuar na prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade com as normas legais (NRs). Inspecionar locais de trabalho, orienta sobre o uso de EPIs/EPCs, realizar treinamentos, investigar acidentes e elaborar documentos técnicos.
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:
Prevenção e Inspeção: Realizar vistorias diárias para identificar riscos, inspecionar máquinas, equipamentos e garantir o uso correto de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPCs (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva).
Gestão de Riscos: Mapear riscos (físicos, químicos, biológicos, ergonômicos) e desenvolver planos de ação para mitigá-los.
Treinamentos e Cultura: Organizar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas de segurança, prevenção de incêndios e primeiros socorros, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
Documentação e Conformidade: Elaborar relatórios, laudos técnicos, investiga acidentes de trabalho para evitar repetições e assegura que a empresa cumpra a legislação trabalhista.
Apoio a Emergências: Coordenar planos de evacuação e atua diretamente em situações de emergência. Formação Necessária:
É preciso ter curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, e experiência comprovada em carteira, desejável em Industria.

title: Power platform developer
description:
POSITION TITLE: Microsoft Power Platform Developer (individual contractor 6 – 12-month term with the possibility of extension, remote in Brazil)
JOB OVERVIEW:
Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. We are seeking a skilled Microsoft Power Apps Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business applications using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate. This role requires a deep understanding of Power Platform, business process approval workflow, to create efficient and scalable solutions that meet our business needs.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Design, develop and maintain Power Platform Applications (specifically Dynamics) and related components (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate).
• Experience writing and maintaining Power Platform flows for automation and system efficiency.
• Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.
• Integrate Power Platform with other Microsoft services including Power BI, and Share Point.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform solutions.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure effective utilization of developed applications.
• Working remotely cover 4 hours of US Pacific time zone (between 9:00am – 5:00pm PST).
JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
• Experience with Microsoft Share Point, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred.
WORK LOCATION:
Remote in Brazil

We need tutors who can start immediately!
Characteristics
Payment in dollars.

Start: Immediate
Duration: Indefinite

Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
General Chemistry
Organic Chemistry
Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.

title: Brazil packaging salesperson, remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.
Role Description
We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.
Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands
- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market
- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements
- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting
- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction
- Meeting and exceeding sales targets
- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets
Qualifications
- Proven track record of successful B2 B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries
- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers
- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements
- Fluent in English and Portuguese
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field
- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools
- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?
Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you’ll do..
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates
This is not a passive customer success role.
It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You’ll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results
What you’ll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Líder de logística e planejamento de demanda
description:
A So Energy é um fornecedor global de Energy as a Service , garantindo soluções personalizadas para uma ampla gama de organizações e indústrias em todo o mundo.
Estamos com uma oportunidade para: Líder de Logística e Planejamento de Demanda – Rio de Janeiro (RJ)
Breve resumo da posição:
Esta posição tem papel estratégico na liderança das operações logísticas e do planejamento de demanda, sendo responsável por transformar a área de logística de um modelo transacional para um modelo estratégico. Atuará na definição e implementação da estratégia logística, otimização de fluxos inbound e outbound, gestão de fornecedores críticos e integração com áreas-chave do negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, competitividade de custos e suporte ao crescimento da empresa.
O que buscamos (requisitos necessários)?
Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
Vivência sólida em logística em empresas multinacionais;
Atuação prévia em posição de liderança na área de logística;
Forte conhecimento em logística inbound e outbound, comércio exterior e fluxos industriais de produção;
Experiência com sistemas ERP, como SAP e/ou Totvs;
Vivência tanto no lado cliente quanto fornecedor em operações logísticas (ex.: portos, freight forwarders – exceto despachante aduaneiro);
Inglês em nível avançado.
Quais serão suas responsabilidades?
Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de logística e supervisionar as atividades de todas as equipes logísticas.
Construir operações de transporte confiáveis e competitivas em custos.
Gerenciar contratos e entregáveis de Freight Forwarders, Despachantes Aduaneiros e demais fornecedores da cadeia de transporte.
Definir e implementar a estratégia e os KPIs para mobilização e desmobilização de equipamentos.
Desenhar e implementar as tecnologias e os sistemas de informação logística da empresa, visando aumentar eficiência, rentabilidade, crescimento e nível de serviço ao cliente.
Identificar e solucionar ineficiências de rotas.
Implementar o processo de planejamento de demanda para atender às previsões de vendas.
Monitorar e controlar os níveis de estoque.
Assegurar conformidade com as regulamentações de transporte e comércio internacional.
Desenvolver, implementar e acompanhar KPIs de logística, contribuindo para iniciativas de melhoria contínua nos processos logísticos.
Conduzir e liderar projetos de melhoria contínua.
Elaborar Mapas de Fluxo de Valor (Value Stream Maps) e coordenar iniciativas Kaizen.
Transformar o departamento de Logística de transacional para tático e, posteriormente, de tático para estratégico.
Colaborar com as equipes de compras, manutenção e operações para previsão de demanda e otimização de estoques.
Local de trabalho: Local: Centro - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner
